_doc: Derived, non-authoritative build decisions layered on layouts.json. Every entry is listed in the validation report. Authoritative coordinates are never changed here; heights and treatments of compounds the layout leaves open are.

base_kit._doc: Local offsets in metres from pad centre (x east, y north), rotation 0, from build-prompt section 3.

resolution.substation_vs_aisle: The specified substation footprint (y -23..-7) overlaps the 12 m service aisle band (y -32..-20) by 3 m. The aisle is kept at y=-26 and full width from x=-90 to +48; east of the refineries it bends 3 m south (centre y=-29) between x=+48 and +90 so the substation keeps its specified centre. Reported as a layout conflict.

01:container-port.note: Port terrace lowered to 6 m with a quay wall on its sea side; the west-flank road keeps its 24 m corridor through the compound.

02:radar.note: Capture compound straddles the central-spine road; radar mast placed outside the road clear width.
